verdict.rationale: Two live probes confirm Skyfire serves an llms.txt at docs.skyfire.xyz (HTTP 200, keyless) describing the developer portal, and its doc pages are published as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), and the full contents and coverage of the llms.txt are not evidenced beyond its header.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.skyfire.xyz/llms.txt # Skyfire Developer Portal Documentation
docs.skyfire.xyz serves llms.txt keylessly ('# Skyfire Developer Portal Documentation... the open identity and payments layer for AI agents')
